title: Are Marie Curie's Notebooks Still Radioactive?

input.text:
Curie's notebooks are still kept in lead-lined boxes.

Yes. Marie Curie's notebooks are still radioactive, and her papers are kept in lead-lined boxes in Paris.

Guess how long those notebooks stay radioactive?

Full film on YouTube. Link in bio.
